description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal MathJax: LaTeX for Drupal allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects MathJax: LaTeX for Drupal versions: from 0.0.0 to 4.1.2.
